bio.summary: Jonah, the Reluctant Prophet (Eager) is a fictional historical figure (public domain; KJV words) standup performer. Fugitive prophet of Nineveh. Ran from the assignment, sulked under a plant, resented the plant's death more than the city's survival. Second-most-famous coward in the canon, first-most in his own opinion. The act circles checking hourly whether the city has repented yet and the plant. Onstage the register is wired.
